run_bitcoin_price_server: run a fastapi server that serves bitcoin price prediction endpoints from btcusd 1 minute data
get_price_by_date: get the average bitcoin price for a specific date in YYYY-MM-DD format
get_stat_by_date_range: get the highest, lowest, and average bitcoin prices for a given date range
get_trend_by_date_range: get daily open, high, low, close, and volume bitcoin price trends for up to 30 days
get_current_date: get the current date in YYYY-MM-DD format
